_provenance.real_data_gap: Cross-section surveys (current-meter measurements, bathymetric profiles) unavailable via USGS NWIS machine-readable API since Oct 2026 format change to JS/HTML. Integration framework defined in replay/hydraulics.py (load_usgs_cross_section).
_provenance.what_is_real: DEM elevation data is a real measurement; derived depth/width/area from DEM is authored interpretation, not direct bathymetric survey.
_provenance.what_needs_real_data: In-situ cross-section surveys (bank slope, bottom profile, velocity-area measurements) to calibrate Manning's n and validate trapezoidal geometry assumptions.
